title: Injective tangent map gives surjective cotangent map
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism locally of finite type between schemes over a field $k$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $x\in X$ and $y=f(x)$ be closed points with residue fields equal to $k$. If the induced map on tangent spaces $T_{X/k,x}\to T_{Y/k,y}$ is injective, then the induced local-ring map gives a surjection $\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2\to\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2$ on cotangent spaces. (Stacks Project, Varieties, Tag 0B2E.)
